title: In NATO’s Next Act, Can Europe Play the Leading Role?

title: Joining a Human Tide of Mourners Flowing Through Tehran’s Streets
description: After days of public mourning ceremonies in the Iranian capital, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei’s coffin arrived in Tehran’s Azadi Square. This is what I saw covering the miles-long procession on Monday.
